# Index lifecycle and health — concept pack

> Creating, naming, listing, hiding and dropping indexes (createIndex/createIndexes, CREATE INDEX [CONCURRENTLY], rolling and staged builds, backfill), index definitions and key patterns, and the failure modes: unused and redundant indexes, too many indexes and write overhead, index size, REINDEX, and Performance Advisor suggestions. Child pack of Indexing.
